rows.title: hr performance reviews handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] hr performance reviews records verified in status "submitted" must be moved to status "draft". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: hr performance reviews handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For hr performance reviews records verified in status "submitted": if the record's employee_id is "15", move it to status "acknowledged"; otherwise move it to status "draft". Apply exactly one transition.

rows.title: hr performance reviews handling procedure
rows.body: [CURRENT] Routine guidance for hr performance reviews records; no transitions are mandated by this document.
